name: submit_partner_inquiry
description: Submit a partnership inquiry for a senior living community, health plan, caregiver network, or aging-services organization. Collect first name, last name, work email, organization name, organization type, and a short description of what they need before calling. Ask preferred contact method; a phone number is required when the caller prefers a call back.

phone.description: Phone number; required when preferred_contact is phone

organization.description: Organization name, e.g. Sunrise Senior Living

role.description: Contact's role or title, if offered

preferred_contact.description: How the partnership team should reply

message.description: What the organization needs help with
